final_message:
I made two small style fixes and the build passes. I did not run the unit tests or Playwright, and I did not read any refreshed screenshots, so the changes are not visually verified.

I read all six screenshots: desktop and mobile for primary, staff-desk and admin-dashboard. The pages are mostly clear, with no overflow in any image. I found two problems:

- **Wrapped ticket number:** on the mobile staff desk, the "Next customer" stat split the ticket number across two lines ("CEN-" / "GC-003"). In `src/styles/components.css`, `.stat-value` now scales its font size to the screen width and stays on one line.
- **Low prominence on ticket cards:** Position and Est. wait looked the same as the service and branch line. In `src/styles/pages.css`, `.ticket-metric` is now larger and bold.

I did not change the design tokens. I have not tested the narrower stat text on screens under about 360px. I wrote `../quality/polish.md` with the findings and these limits, and it does not claim final visual approval.
